BiblicalUsage: Ezra counts the years in Aramaic: the work on the house of God stops until the second year of Darius, and Daniel is named in the first year of Belshazzar and the first year of Darius.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the years of kings are short and counted, and God's years are the ones that stand.
